instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Forge Networks is a Micro MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) specializing in providing cost-effective mobile voice and data plans, primarily targeting the price-sensitive youth market. We leverage a lean, tech-first approach to manage complex regulatory compliance inherent in network operations while scaling our service delivery through automated digital channels.
answers.pastInitiatives: We attempted to introduce a weekly innovation brainstorming session across departments, but attendance dropped rapidly after the first month. Participants felt the sessions generated interesting ideas but had no clear path to execution or budget. The initiative faded without producing any tangible outcome.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions.
answers.additionalContext: Currently, the company struggles with manual provisioning processes which lead to high operational overhead and slow deployment times. Furthermore, navigating evolving regulatory requirements related to data localization and consumer protection presents a constant risk that requires proactive technological adaptation.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Dynamic Resource Allocation Engine (Network Efficiency)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a radical, AI/ML model to dynamically allocate network slices and resources based on real-time demand patterns, significantly reducing operational expenditure in data transmission. This moves beyond simple optimization into predictive cost avoidance.

first_actions: Conduct a 4-week PoC identifying high-cost usage patterns across the current network infrastructure.
Identify and onboard a specialized external ML consultant focused on telecom efficiency algorithms.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Seed funding for cloud computing resources ($5k)
Contracting a specialized AI/ML engineering resource (part-time)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average operational cost per subscriber by 10% within 9 months.
milestones: PoC completion and MVP framework setup (Month 3)
Pilot deployment on a single regional network segment (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Automated Customer Onboarding Workflow
opportunities.rationale: Implement a self-service, automated onboarding portal to drastically reduce the labor required for new subscriber setup and plan migration. This directly addresses process inefficiencies and frees up limited talent.

first_actions: Map the current manual provisioning steps and identify bottlenecks.
Select a low-code platform (e.g., Salesforce integration) for initial workflow automation.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average customer onboarding cycle time from 48 hours to under 1 hour.
milestones: Full deployment and user training completion (Month 5)

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated, cross-functional efficiency task force to prioritize and budget the AI PoC.
Launch the automated onboarding pilot project using existing internal development cycles.

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leads to inconsistent execution and idea abandonment.
Severe talent scarcity, forcing generalist developers into unsustainable operational maintenance roles.
Minimal budget allocation (12%) prevents meaningful investment in long-term strategic technology or R&D.
High technical debt due to rushed development cycles prioritizing short-term fixes over scalable architecture.
